simple.meaning: אָצַר (ʼâtsar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to store up.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 5 times in 2 Kings, Nehemiah, Isaiah, Amos, beginning at 2 Kings 20:17. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, faith, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָצַר (H686) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אָצַר (ʼâtsar) / H686 is traced through 2 Kings 20:17, Nehemiah 13:13, Isaiah 23:18, Isaiah 39:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

timeline.evidenceText: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.

Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.
“Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh,

definitions.full: H686. atsar [ אָצַר ] verb lay up, store up (Mishna id. , Aramaic אֲצַר , , Arabic confine, restrict ) — Qal Perfect 3plural אָֽצְרוּ 2Kin 20:17 ; Isa 39:6 ; Participle הָאֹצְרִים Amos 3:10 ; — store up ) treasure 2Kin 20:17 = Isa 39:6 ; object וָשֹׁד חָמָס Amos 3:10 , i.e. treasure gained by violence robbery. Niph`al Imperfect יֵאָצֵר be stored up, of the merchandise of Tyre Isa 23:18 . Hiph`il Imperfect וָאוֺצְרָה (compare Kö i, 391 ) ( denominative from אוֺצָר ) Neh 13:13 and I appointed treasurer , followed by accusative of person + עַלאֿוֺצָרוֺת .
